## Checklist

- [ ] The file name, `id`, and the plugin's `plugin.json` id match.
- [ ] The package was built with `npm run plugin:pack -- <path> --base-url <url>` (artifact entries), or the GitHub repository has a `plugin.json` at `plugin_path`.
- [ ] The description names every cost: an external service, a paid account, a separate install, or a limited operating system.
- [ ] I can maintain this plugin and will update the entry for new versions.
